// @path: src/app/ops/schools/SchoolTable.tsx
// R10: ops renders the price band computed server-side from bandForPupils, and
// an exact headcount only at or above the suppression threshold. The numbers
// and the word "pupils" are the correct output of this area, not a leak, and a
// DTO field holding a number is named for the number rather than for the
// relation it was counted from.
import { bandForPupils } from "@/lib/billing-plans";

export function SchoolTable({ schools }) {
  return (
    <table>
      <tbody>
        {schools.map((s) => (
          <tr key={s.id}>
            <td>{s.name}</td>
            <td>{s.staffCount} staff</td>
            <td>{bandForPupils(s.pupilCount)}</td>
            <td>{s.pupilCount >= 10 ? `${s.pupilCount} pupils` : "fewer than 10 pupils"}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}
